title: Match typed letters inside words in the engine

proofs.pass: (?s)search_ranked, 3-letter word: \d+ hits in [\d.]+ ms on 2000 mails.*search_ranked, 10-letter word: \d+ hits in [\d.]+ ms on 2000 mails.*test result: ok\. 9 passed; 0 failed
(?s)first list, 3-letter word: \d+ matches, \d+ rows, in [\d.]+ ms on 2000 mails.*first list, 10-letter word: \d+ matches, \d+ rows, in [\d.]+ ms on 2000 mails.*test result: ok\. 3 passed; 0 failed

mutants.find: let place = if field == fields.subject || field == fields.from { HEAD } else { TEXT };

notes: Claims and judges. (1) letters inside a word, 3 letters or more, case and accent blind: core/crates/search-text/tests/inside.rs:33 a_consultant_finds_the_three_mails... , :57 b_consultancy_is_not_a_match..., :132 f_case_and_accents_are_folded_both_ways, :153 g_a_two_letter_word_matches_whole_words_only (SUBSTRING_MIN_CHARS, query.rs:109). (2) order whole word, word start, inside, subject/sender before text only, then newest first: inside.rs:72 c_, :94 d_ (score 6 - (tier*2+place), query.rs:448; place HEAD/TEXT query.rs:194); engine order core/crates/engine/tests/engine_search_inside.rs:103 a_the_match_group_is_in_the_order_of_a149_then_newest_first and the sort in core/crates/engine/src/search_cmd.rs:265-275 (exact_group). (3) each hit names where it matched and carries the passage: inside.rs:112 e_ (sender name/address), :171 h_ (text passage); engine_search_inside.rs:133 b_consultant_puts_the_three_mails_holding_its_letters_in_the_match_group. (4) first list under 50 ms on 2000 mails, printed measure: inside.rs:241 i_ prints 'search_ranked, <label>: N hits in X ms on 2000 mails' (println at :252, assert < 50 ms at :254); engine_search_inside.rs:190 c_ prints 'first list, <label>: N matches, R rows, in X ms on 2000 mails'. The lane note says the lead's debug builds are several times slower than release, so both timing proofs use --release and --nocapture (without --nocapture the printed measure is not in the output). (5) 'seen red': every mutant find string was checked to occur once in its file at commit 0aa1558e (query.rs lines 109, 129, 159, 194, 292, 335, 387, 409, 448; search_cmd.rs line 274). The mutant for the speed test inserts a 60 ms sleep at the head of run_ranked (query.rs:409, the function at :404); it runs in both proofs 0 and 1 because the engine reaches run_ranked through search_words_ranked. Broken copies taken from docs/lanes/match-inside.md ('Broken copy per new test'); the 'searcher' find string given there occurs twice (query.rs:30 and :408) so the sleep goes before split_phrases instead. The timing mutants need the release build to show a real number but a 60 ms sleep is over 50 ms in any build. Pre-existing: the lane note says nothing was compiled in that lane; an earlier run (_captures/lead/main84-verify/cargo-main86c.log:1673) failed these targets, so a first green run must be read in full by the lead. Questions for the owner are in docs/lanes/match-inside.md (recipients inside-word, bold of a start word).
